reasoning: The landscape plan shows overhead electric (OHE) infrastructure along the southern boundary of the site. Vision analysis indicated that mitigation trees (M) in the southeast corner appear very close to the OHE line. I need to verify whether these trees meet the minimum clearance requirements from the electric utility poles and conductors. For distribution lines, non-utility-compatible trees must be ≥15 feet from conductors, and any trees must be ≥10 feet from poles. If these are large trees (mature height ≥40 feet), they must be ≥25 feet from distribution conductors. Measuring actual distances will determine compliance or identify violations.
